caveats:
The spatial accuracy of these dataset depends on both the quality of the input data and the correctness of edits applied throughout the development process. Due to the compressed production timeline, unintended errors or omissions may remain in some areas, as priority was given to timely data release in support of emergency response activities.

This dataset should be considered operational; it has not been fully validated by government authorities. Its production is part of ongoing work, and additional edits and refinements are expected in future releases. 

The data herein are not guaranteed to be fully accurate or clean. Users who encounter apparent errors or misstatements are encouraged to contact CIESIN at info@ciesin.columbia.edu. Feedback and corrections from local stakeholders are welcomed and will help inform subsequent updates.

CIESIN, Columbia University, and their sponsors provide these data on a “where is, as is” basis, without any express or implied warranty. They do not guarantee the quality, applicability, accuracy, reliability, or completeness of the data and shall not be held liable for any incidental, consequential, or special damages arising from their use.

name: grid3-cod-nord-kivu-geospatial-data-layers
notes:
The GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers 20260731 provides geospatial layers for Nord-Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, including: 

Settlement names,
Health facilities,
Health zones, and
Health areas.

This data package supersedes the v8.0 GRID3 COD health areas, health facilities, health zones, and settlement names layers for Nord-Kivu Province only. It does not supersede versions of these layers for other provinces or geographies.

This dataset may contain unintended omissions, as it was developed under a compressed timeline to enable timely information sharing and support teams engaged in emergency response efforts.

This dataset should be considered operational; it has not been fully validated by government authorities. Its production is part of ongoing work, and additional edits and refinements are expected in future releases. 

Dataset citation

Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2026. GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers 20260731. New York: Columbia University. https://data.humdata.org/dataset/grid3-cod-nord-kivu-geospatial-data-layers. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR.

Contacts and data queries

The authors of this dataset appreciate feedback regarding the data, including suggestions, discovery of errors, difficulties in using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please send an email to: info@ciesin.columbia.edu

organization.description:
GRID3 works with countries in sub-Saharan Africa to generate, validate, and use core spatial datasets on population, settlements, subnational boundaries, and crucial infrastructure. We train and support stakeholders who use this information for analytics and decision-making, and work closely with local governments to improve national ownership and sustainability of the data.

We blend official data with data generated by novel approaches; our solutions draw on advanced data science and technology, participatory mapping, satellite imagery, and other innovations. GRID3 combines the expertise of leading technical partners to design pragmatic and responsive geospatial solutions that address the priority needs of each country.

Our work facilitates data-driven interventions that reach communities that need them the most. GRID3 solutions are valuable across multiple development sectors, from education to infrastructure. Our current focus is improving health interventions—particularly immunization coverage and malaria control—in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Nigeria.
